paths.description: Public homepage and age-assurance entry gate, representing the primary browse journey.
Amateur category listing, representing listing and taxonomy templates.
Representative video detail page, covering media, metadata and content-detail structure.
Search results for a benign query, representing discovery and mobile results.
Account creation/sign-in surface, representing forms, authentication and commercial upsell.
Unknown route, representing HTTP failure and recovery messaging.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to the user’s dark-mode preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is visually identical to the light capture, and the computed root colorScheme is “normal”.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: Platform probe found no view-transition CSS across the rendered stylesheet set.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document or cross-document View Transitions for major route/state changes, while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome is not scroll-state aware.
findings.evidence: CSS probe found no modern scroll-state or scroll-timeline treatment; the navigation remains fixed in the captured listing state.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS scroll-state/container-query patterns for sticky navigation feedback where useful.

findings.summary: The mandatory age gate is an ad-hoc div rather than an accessible modal primitive.
findings.evidence: DOM probe identifies #disclaimer_background as a DIV with no dialog role or aria-modal, despite blocking the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the gate with <dialog> (or equivalent fully accessible dialog semantics), focus containment, labelled description and explicit close/continue behavior.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport styling rather than container responsiveness.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container rules, although cards and account panels are reused across wide and narrow layouts.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and component-local @container rules for reusable cards, navigation and account panels.

findings.summary: Performance is inconsistent across key templates.
findings.evidence: Homepage trace measured LCP 1.06s with no TBT, but Lighthouse on the account path measured LCP 4.8s, FCP 3.5s and TTI 8.5s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the account LCP resource, shorten render-blocking chains and defer non-critical work.

findings.summary: The mobile homepage has excessive layout shift.
findings.evidence: The layout observer measured CLS 0.172 across three shifts, above the 0.1 good threshold; 99 of 100 images lack explicit dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image and banner space with width/height or aspect-ratio and stabilise late content and font metrics.

findings.summary: Critical resource delivery is inefficient.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 120 requests and 2.82 MB, including parser-inserted CSS/scripts; Lighthouse estimated 2.55s render-blocking savings and flagged inefficient cache lifetimes.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, set durable cache headers and use preload/fetchpriority only for verified critical resources.

findings.summary: Large unused CSS and JavaScript are shipped.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 246 KiB unused CSS and 406 KiB unused JavaScript; the largest script transferred 517 KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by template and interaction, remove unused CSS/JS and conditionally load the media stack.

findings.summary: Many controls and images lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe counted 103 unnamed buttons and 4 empty links; the image audit found 98 images without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control an accessible name and provide meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative thumbnails.

findings.summary: Text and UI contrast fail on the account page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility reported a failing color-contrast audit and an accessibility score of 0.80.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text, border and surface tokens to meet WCAG contrast ratios in all states.

findings.summary: Page structure lacks a main landmark and primary headings.
findings.evidence: Homepage and category probes found no H1; Lighthouse reports no main landmark on the account document.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive H1 and a <main> landmark per template, preserving a logical heading hierarchy.

findings.summary: At least one key page restricts user zoom.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports user-scalable=no or maximum-scale below 5 on the account page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 without disabling pinch zoom; verify reflow at 200% and 400%.

findings.summary: The account page logs browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the errors-in-console audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve each console error and add production monitoring that catches uncaught exceptions without noisy expected failures.

findings.summary: Image assets are not soundly sized or delivered.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 99/100 missing dimensions, 100/100 without srcset and 99 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources and modern formats with appropriate fallbacks.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found one deprecated-API warning and four BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated APIs and remove unload/runtime blockers so navigations can use BFCache.

findings.summary: Localized listing and detail pages have incomplete canonical/localization signals.
findings.evidence: The category metadata probe found no canonical or hreflang links; the detail probe also returned no canonical despite a redirected localized URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-consistent canonical and hreflang links for localized public templates and keep sitemap URLs aligned.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie posture need hardening.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no HSTS or nosniff, CSP permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval, and the session cookie uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable HSTS and nosniff, migrate inline/eval code to nonce/hash-based CSP, and use the strictest viable SameSite cookie policy.

findings.summary: Authentication lacks phishing-resistant sign-in and complete autofill semantics.
findings.evidence: The account page exposes password-only sign-in, no passkey action, and email/current-password fields have empty autocomplete values.
findings.suggestedFix: Add WebAuthn/passkeys and correct username, email, current-password and new-password autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy coverage is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no Permissions-Policy, no HSTS and a permissive CSP; Referrer-Policy remains no-referrer-when-downgrade.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive Permissions-Policy, strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter), CSP frame-ancestors and stronger XSS defenses.

findings.summary: Localized layout CSS is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The French document has lang=fr, but the style probe found zero logical-property uses and 21 physical left/right declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Use inline/block logical properties and verify RTL/writing-mode behavior; set dir explicitly when locale direction requires it.

findings.summary: Sign-in and sign-up fields omit important autofill tokens.
findings.evidence: Rendered form evidence shows empty autocomplete on email/current-password and several sign-up fields; only new-password is identified.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply correct autocomplete tokens for email/username/current-password/new-password and profile fields.

findings.summary: The thumbnail grid ships unoptimised image assets.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 99 legacy images, 100 without srcset and 99 without dimensions; images account for 1.72 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive variants sized to rendered slots, with dimensions and effective CDN caching.

findings.summary: Below-fold media is fetched eagerly.
findings.evidence: 90 below-fold images lack loading=lazy; 106 image requests contribute to 120 requests on initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, virtualise long grids and avoid background work until content approaches the viewport.

findings.summary: The initial media and CDN request budget is disproportionate.
findings.evidence: 116 of 120 requests and 2.77 MB are to CDN origins, before the user chooses a video.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a template budget, defer low-value thumbnails/media and batch CDN work around viewport demand.

findings.summary: The account page has a heavy baseline heap footprint.
findings.evidence: Heap summary measured 316,804 nodes and 22.2 MB self size for a relatively simple account surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile native-node retention, remove unnecessary hidden UI/template state and conditionally initialise unrelated site features.

taskList.title: Repair accessibility semantics, names, contrast, zoom and document structure
Harden headers, CSP, cookies and authentication with passkeys/autofill
Stabilise layout and optimise the account critical rendering path
Reduce eager thumbnail/media work and modernise responsive image delivery
Split unused CSS/JS and reduce the account page heap footprint
Add preference, container, transition and localized indexing support
Resolve console, deprecated API and BFCache failures
